facts.label: Post-Flye processing (confirmed log)
facts.value: Plassembler selected reads, corrected them and ran a separate plasmid reconstruction. The final plasmid is not simply a copy of the initial Flye contig.

facts.label: What the stage comparison establishes
facts.value: An exact initial Flye assessment and a non-exact final output are recorded. The saved records do not identify which intervening step introduced the two differences.
